FurinaKit V66 — optional offline speech components

The Python ctypes declarations in tts_sherpa.py are adapted from the public C API
header of k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx v1.13.8 (Xiaomi Corporation and contributors), under
Apache License 2.0. The complete Apache license is distributed alongside this
notice and is available in About. FurinaKit's binding is a modified, minimal
subset for the pinned ABI; it is not an upstream Python package.
Source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/blob/v1.13.8/sherpa-onnx/c-api/c-api.h
Runtime: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/v1.13.8

The runtime and models are NOT included in the application and are NOT downloaded
on startup. They are fetched only after an explicit user download request. All
files in the verified upstream archive, including LICENSE, COPYING, NOTICE and
attribution files, are retained. A runtime license does not override the licenses
of its dependencies, models, datasets or voice recordings. In particular, eSpeak
NG uses GPL terms; consult the exact distributed archive and upstream sources:
https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

Optional model provenance:
1. Kokoro 82M v1.1 Chinese/English, INT8 sherpa conversion. The upstream model card
   states Apache-2.0 and credits LongMaoData for the Chinese training data.
   https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M-v1.1-zh
   Conversion and speaker mapping:
   https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/1942
2. Piper en_US LJSpeech medium, INT8 sherpa conversion. Its model card describes
   LJSpeech data as public domain and attributes training to Bryce Beattie.
   Dataset status is not a blanket license for every dependency in the package.
   https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/blob/main/en/en_US/ljspeech/medium/MODEL_CARD
   https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/
   https://brycebeattie.com/files/tts/
3. Piper en_US Ryan medium, INT8 sherpa conversion. IMPORTANT: the model card lists
   RyanSpeech data under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (NON-COMMERCIAL), and says the model was
   fine-tuned from Lessac medium. Do not assume commercial use is permitted.
   https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/blob/main/en/en_US/ryan/medium/MODEL_CARD
   https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/roholazandie/ryanspeech
   https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/

Model archives and pinned SHA-256/byte sizes are listed in tts_components.py.
Model cards were consulted on 2026-09-19. No runtime/model binary was downloaded
while preparing this source-only modification. Deployment must retain this notice
and the full sherpa-onnx Apache license, as well as all original archive notices.

Online Edge speech is an independent, unofficial client of Microsoft's Read Aloud
endpoint. No Microsoft service availability or affiliation is promised. Text is
sent to Microsoft only when the user requests online synthesis. Windows SAPI and
installed offline models do not send synthesis text to an online speech service.
